# Gordon Burgett

> Fractional AI engineer in Dallas-Fort Worth. I help small and mid-sized businesses with AI-connected company knowledge bases, custom CRMs, and AI strategy.

Gordon Burgett is a fractional AI engineer based in Dallas-Fort Worth. He works with small and mid-sized businesses on a retainer: connecting company knowledge to AI, building custom CRMs (including CRMs on Notion), thinking through AI strategy, go-to-market engineering, and evals for companies that are building AI features.

The business site is https://dfwfractionalfde.com. This site, https://gordonburgett.net, is his writing and background.

## Offers

- AI-connected company knowledge bases
- Custom CRMs, including CRMs built on Notion
- Strategic AI thought partnership
- Go-to-market engineering
- Evals for companies building AI features
